title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing managers promote businesses, services, products, or brands. They develop marketing and pricing strategies, generate new business leads, and oversee marketing department staff. They also manage marketing budgets and analyze trends. I• Develop marketing strategies after performing the necessary research and then use this information to create strategies that are aimed at meeting the company's marketing and business goals.

Key Skills: Brand strategy,Brand management,Marketing,Brand,Management,Marketing management
